hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: How ITOS, a Sweden-based business, handles personal data under the GDPR and applicable Swedish law.

intro: This Privacy Policy explains how ITOS, based in Sweden, collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you use this website, contact ITOS, or request services.
ITOS aims to process personal data transparently, securely, and in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Swedish data protection law.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your personal data
paragraphs: ITOS is a Sweden-based business operating from Charlottenberg, Sweden. For the purposes of this website and client communication, ITOS acts as the data controller for personal data described in this policy.
If you have questions about privacy, personal data, or your rights, you can contact ITOS by email at 5441700@gmail.com.

sections.title: What personal data we may collect
items: Contact details you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, and business details.
The contents of messages, project requests, and other information you submit through the contact form, email, or phone.
Technical and usage information about visits to the website, but only where optional analytics have been accepted.
Records needed to prepare quotes, provide services, answer questions, and maintain business communication.

sections.title: Why we use personal data
items: To respond to inquiries and communicate with potential or existing clients.
To prepare proposals, provide requested services, and manage project-related communication.
To operate, secure, and improve the website and its content.
To measure website performance through analytics where you have given consent.
To comply with accounting, tax, legal, or regulatory obligations under Swedish and EU law.

sections.title: Legal bases under the GDPR
items: Consent — for optional analytics cookies and related measurement tools.
Pre-contractual steps or contract performance — when you ask for a quote, discuss a project, or become a client.
Legitimate interests — for day-to-day business communication, site security, and service improvement where those interests are not overridden by your rights.
Legal obligation — where information must be retained or disclosed to comply with applicable law.

sections.title: Sharing data with service providers
paragraphs: ITOS may use trusted service providers to help operate the website and deliver services, for example hosting providers, website infrastructure, analytics providers, and communication or form-handling tools such as EmailJS.

These providers only receive personal data where necessary for their role and are expected to process it under appropriate confidentiality and data protection obligations. ITOS does not sell your personal data.

sections.title: International data transfers
paragraphs: Some providers used by ITOS may process data outside the EU or EEA. Where that happens, appropriate safeguards such as contractual protections, standard contractual clauses, or other lawful transfer mechanisms required under the GDPR are used where applicable.

sections.title: How long we keep data
paragraphs: Personal data is kept only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including responding to inquiries, managing ongoing business relationships, providing services, and meeting legal or accounting requirements.

If you contact ITOS but do not become a client, your information is generally kept only as long as reasonably necessary to manage the conversation and any follow-up, unless it must be retained for legal reasons.

sections.title: Your rights
items: The right to access your personal data.
The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
The right to request deletion where applicable.
The right to restrict processing in certain situations.
The right to object to processing based on legitimate interests.
The right to data portability where the GDPR applies.
The right to withdraw consent at any time for processing based on consent, including analytics cookies.

sections.title: Complaints and supervisory authority
paragraphs: If you believe your personal data has been handled unlawfully, you have the right to contact ITOS first so the issue can be reviewed.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY), which is the supervisory authority in Sweden for data protection matters.

hero.title: Cookie Policy
hero.description: How ITOS uses cookies and similar technologies on this website, including analytics tools that are only activated after consent.

intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, which cookies may be used on this website, and how you can manage your preferences.
Because ITOS is a Sweden-based business serving users in Sweden and the EU, ITOS uses a consent-based approach for optional analytics in line with GDPR and ePrivacy expectations.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They can help a website remember your preferences, understand traffic patterns, and improve the user experience.

sections.title: Types of cookies we use
items: Strictly necessary cookies — required for essential website functions, including remembering your cookie preference.
Analytics cookies — used only after your consent to understand traffic and improve the website.

sections.title: Essential consent cookie
paragraphs: When you interact with the cookie banner, your choice is stored in a small preference cookie and local browser storage so the site can remember whether you accepted or rejected optional analytics.
The current cookie name used for this purpose is itos_cookie_consent. This cookie is necessary to respect your choice and does not require optional analytics consent.

sections.title: Analytics cookies and tools
paragraphs: If you accept analytics, this website may load Google Analytics (Google tag / GA4) and, where temporarily enabled, other analytics tools to measure visits, page views, and general website usage.

These tools may set their own measurement cookies or use similar technologies. They are not activated until you provide consent through the cookie banner. If you reject optional cookies, analytics remain disabled.

sections.title: How to manage your choices
items: You can accept or reject optional analytics from the cookie banner when you first visit the site.
You can reopen the banner later using the Cookie settings button in the footer.
You can also manage or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: When analytics are enabled, Google and any temporarily enabled analytics provider may process technical data about your visit as independent providers under their own privacy and cookie documentation.
Where third-party providers process data outside the EU or EEA, appropriate safeguards required under the GDPR are used where applicable.

sections.title: Updates and contact
paragraphs: This Cookie Policy may be updated from time to time to reflect legal, technical, or business changes. The latest update date is shown at the top of this page.
If you have questions about cookies or privacy on this website, contact ITOS at 5441700@gmail.com.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the complexity. A simple landing page starts from 2,200 SEK / €190. A multi-page business website costs 5,000–10,000 SEK, and an advanced website with integrations costs 10,000–25,000 SEK. The first consultation is free — I'll give you an exact quote after reviewing your needs.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: A simple website takes 1–2 weeks, a standard business website 2–4 weeks, and a complex project with integrations 4–6 weeks. The timeline depends on how quickly you provide content and feedback.

items.question: Do you work with clients across Sweden?
items.answer: Yes, I work fully remotely and serve clients throughout Sweden, Norway, and the EU. Location is not a barrier — all communication, delivery, and support happen online.

items.question: What is included in the free consultation?
items.answer: The free consultation lasts 30–60 minutes. I review your goals, current situation, and challenges, then suggest practical solutions. No pressure — you get clarity on the next steps with no obligations.

items.question: Do I need a CRM system?
items.answer: If you have more than 10 active clients and find yourself losing track of contacts, follow-ups, or deals — yes, a CRM will save you time and money. I work with PlanFix and Bitrix24 and handle the full setup, customisation, and training.

items.question: Do you work only with Swedish companies?
items.answer: No, I also work with companies in Norway and across the EU. I provide services in three languages — Swedish, English, and Russian — so the language is never a barrier.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: For projects: 50% upfront at the start, 50% upon delivery. For ongoing support: monthly invoicing. Payment methods include bank transfer (faktura with 30-day terms) and Swish for smaller amounts. Instalments are possible for larger projects.

items.question: What is included in post-launch support?
items.answer: Post-launch support includes updates, bug fixes, technical assistance, and small improvements. The rate is 300–800 SEK/hour, and monthly support packages are also available from 2,000 SEK/month.
